1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __1000__ Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a __different__ multivalent cation crosslinker.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __a polyalkylenimine selected from the group consisting of polyethylenimine and polypropylenimine__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and __other__ anionic surfactants.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, __wherein the zirconium compound is present in a concentration that enhances the stability of the nanoparticle__.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium __, calcium, or other cations__.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __is characterized by an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __that is selected from the group consisting of zirconium, chromium, titanium, iron, or aluminum__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising __at least one of Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al in a concentration sufficient to enhance the properties of the composition__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that can be crosslinked with the polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle of claim 1; and c) a fluid. 

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __wherein the polymer is selected to optimize the interaction with the polyelectrolyte complex__. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is __selected from the group consisting of brine, seawater, or other aqueous solutions__.
